title: npm publish pipeline and Homebrew formula preparation
description: WHY: the target end state is brew install boreal-work (or npm i -g) as the only step before bwrk is usable, with the global addon self-bootstrapping on first use. WHAT: (1) npm publish pipeline for the bundled package - package metadata, files whitelist so only dist and required assets ship, provenance, a CI dry-run publish gate, and a versioning policy wired to the repo version; (2) Homebrew formula in a tap repo wrapping the npm tarball with a node dependency (the standard route for node CLIs - do not block on a node-free SEA binary, note it as a future option); (3) documentation: install section rewrite in README.md and docs/getting-started.md covering all three channels plus the install.sh curl one-liner. Publishing credentials and the actual first publish are owner actions - prepare everything up to the point where publish is one command, and record that boundary in the closeout summary.
acceptanceCriteria: npm pack output installs globally in a container or temp prefix and passes the binary smoke test
Formula builds and installs locally via brew install --build-from-source against the packed tarball
Docs cover npm, brew, and install.sh channels
closedReason: release packaging prepared, locally verified, and checkpointed; owner credentials remain for first npm publish and tap push
